+
+## 9. Monthly SKP Document Links Tab (SKP Bulanan)
+
+### Problem
+The user requested a monthly SKP document link grid (January - December) next to the "Summary View SKP" tab, showing rows of SKP items:
+- Sub-activities (Sub Kegiatan) managed by the division (Bidang), retrieved by matching `mappingKegiatanInstansi` to pegawai in the division.
+- Custom manual SKP items added dynamically.
+- Default manual items: `Administrasi PPM` (where "PPM" is dynamic based on selected division) and `Perencanaan dan Pengukuran Kinerja`.
+- Cells should contain copy buttons, pencil edit/pasting buttons, and links to document targets.
+
+### Solution
+- **State & Layout**: Added `activeTab` switching in the page header of [SkpSummary.tsx](file:///d:/SAMP/Frontend/src/features/auth/components/SkpSummary.tsx) to choose between "Summary View", "SKP Bulanan", and "Upload & Kelola Berkas".
+- **Dynamic Items Fetching**:
+  - Implemented `getSubActivitiesForBidang(bidangId)` which maps `mappingKegiatanInstansi` penanggung jawab to pegawai within the division (falling back to typical division-specific sub-activities if empty).
+  - Implemented `getManualItemsForBidang(bidangId)` which combines default manual items (dynamic based on `getBidangSingkatan(bidangId)`) and custom manual items saved in `localStorage` under `skp_manual_skp_items`.
+- **Monthly Grid**:
+  - Implemented `renderMonthlyDocsTab()` returning a beautiful 12-month document link grid for each SKP item (JANUARI to DESEMBER).
+  - Cells with URLs display a clickable blue "Lihat" link, a "Copy" link button (copies to clipboard and shows "Tersalin" temporarily), and an edit pencil button.
+  - Cells without URLs show a grey "+ Link" button.
+- **Custom SKP Items Management**: Added a "+ Tambah Butir SKP" button triggering a modal to add custom manual items, with inline trash icons to delete them.
+- **Persistent Links Saving**: Clicking the pencil or "+ Link" button opens a modal to paste/edit URLs, persisting them in `localStorage` under `skp_monthly_links` with year/division/item/month keys.
+
